title: [Build] NOTICE.md verification script performance improvement and fixes

status.label: Manual review completion required
status.detail: Eight actual automated requests on this exact revision are exhausted. The final substantive result published three optional concerns about concurrency tuning, NOTICE bullet indentation and diagnostic paths. Scoped resource disposal, fail-closed error aggregation, the intentional repository NOTICE format and explicit production caller counter those proposed correctness claims. All were answered and resolved, with zero unresolved threads, but the final requested result was nonzero. The independent Boost inventory concern remains unverified and is not an author-facing finding.
